'''Víctor Bernat Cuadros''' (born 17 May 1987) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Forward (association football)|forward]] for [[FS La Massana|La Massana]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref>{{WorldFootball.net}}</ref>

==Career==
Bernat made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 6 September 2020 in the [[2020–21 UEFA Nations League D|UEFA Nations League]] against the [[Faroe Islands national football team|Faroe Islands]].<ref name="EUF">{{cite web |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=31001 |title=Víctor Bernat |website=EU-Football.info |access-date=6 September 2020}}</ref>
